sources.name: Funding rate history (per exchange futures pages)
sources.note: 0.01%/8h is the long-run neutral average for BTC/USDT perps; actual rates fluctuate with market direction.

binance.description: Funding paid every 8h. Rate fluctuates with market; 0.01% is a long-term average for BTC/USDT.

okx.description: Funding paid every 8h. Rate fluctuates with market.

gate.description: Funding paid every 8h. Rate fluctuates with market.

bybit.description: Funding paid every 8h. Rate fluctuates with market.

mexc.description: Funding paid every 8h for most pairs (a few volatile pairs settle every 4h). Rate fluctuates with market.

bitget.description: Funding settled at 00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC. Rate fluctuates with market.

kucoin.description: Funding paid every 8h for most USDT-margined perpetuals (some pairs settle on 4h/12h/24h schedules). Rate fluctuates with market.

kraken.description: Kraken perpetuals settle funding every 8h (00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC), typically 0.01%-0.05% per period; newer linear Multi-M perpetuals settle hourly instead. Rate fluctuates with market.

hyperliquid.description: Hyperliquid settles funding EVERY HOUR (rate formula is an 8h-equivalent paid at 1/8 per hour; 0.00125%/1h = the same 0.01%/8h neutral average as CEX venues). Rate = avg premium index + clamped interest component, capped at 4%/h, paid P2P on oracle price with no platform cut. Rate fluctuates with market.

bingx.description: Funding settles at 00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC for Standard Contract USDT-margined perpetuals. Rate fluctuates with market; 0.01% is a long-term average for BTC/USDT.

phemex.description: Funding settles every 8h at 00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC for USDT-margined perpetuals. Rate fluctuates with market; 0.01% is a long-term average for BTC/USDT.

blofin.description: BloFin USDT-margined perpetuals settle funding every 8h (00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC; rate cap around ±0.02% for majors). Rate fluctuates with market; 0.01% is a long-term average for BTC/USDT. Verified 2026-09-13.

bitstamp.description: Bitstamp regulated USD-margined perpetuals (EU/EEA eligible clients only via the MiFID-authorized Slovenian entity) settle funding every 8h at 00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC, exchanged peer-to-peer with no platform cut. Rate fluctuates with market; 0.01% is a long-term neutral average for the major crypto perps. Verified 2026-09.
